title: Hymn and Bell
author: Ivo Montrose
blurb: Cyrus Vasquez, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
